create.name: Jerry Z Chang
create.bio:
Jerry Z Chang is a Vancouver energy worker who set up Zenith Healing in 2017. He holds Quantum-Touch practitioner certification and trained as a Reiki master and teacher in the Holy Fire lineage, and he describes his calling as helping people raise their own vibration and draw on their inner wisdom. His one-to-one sessions bring the two methods together and run for thirty, sixty or ninety minutes; he sees clients by appointment around Greater Vancouver and also works at a distance for people who live further away or cannot travel.

Alongside the private work he leads crystal bowl meditation classes in Kitsilano, Marpole and south Surrey, playing a single bowl and following the sound with a shared oracle-card reading and conversation. Through his Meetup community, Spiritual Activities for Happy Living, he also hosts monthly spiritual conversation evenings at a Vancouver café and gentle forest walks on local trails that are treated as walking meditation. He offers oracle-card guidance sessions and teaches an informal, instinctive style of archery as a meditative practice. His YouTube channel, Zenith Healing, carries talks, a sample bowl meditation and outdoor practice films, mostly in English with Chinese subtitles.
